title: Minimax Risk and Honest Intervals for Causal Median Contrasts from Laplace-Privatized Outcomes
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 6.4 < 7.4; NOT salvageable within the same topic/scope by a bounded D0 repair. Mathematical review passed; cited leaf verified.
gap_reasons: The delivered proofs establish matching original-record risk and honest-length orders, including the unknown-propensity upper bound; the matched-frontier framing leaves no identified essential step open. The fixed-error exponent is already supplied by [Dattner–Reiß–Trabs, Corollary 2.9](https://arxiv.org/html/1303.1698v5), and clean-outcome rough-QTE rates by [Zhang–Liu–Zhang, Theorem 5](https://arxiv.org/html/2606.01706v2), so the contribution is the channel-uniform combination and its scale-sensitive correction audit. Its significance remains confined to known uniform scalar design, fixed spatial regularity, globally bounded Lipschitz latent densities and one prescribed channel; it does not establish a broader confounding-versus-inverse-information characterization. The exhibited procedure returns zero and the entire parameter interval whenever n epsilon^3 is at most 2^560, so the finite guarantees supply no usable sample-planning or uncertainty calibration at realistic sample sizes. No delivered implementation or numerical evidence bridges that limitation to the prospective qte consumer, constraining the projected paper score despite the theoretical field contribution. Bonvini's cited conference abstract has no supplied complete theorem text and cannot independently defeat novelty or block the field floor. proof_attempt_summary: Discovery supplied the exact-class original-record risk and honest-length order min{1,(n epsilon^3)^(-2/7)}, matching lower bounds and known-propensity order. Mathematical review passed and the cited Laplace inverse-score source was verified, but the delivered scope and unusably conservative fallback threshold capped novelty at incremental, below field. No Lean formalization, F4/F5 audit, or substrate promotion was performed.
tldr: For the marginal causal median contrast \(\theta(P)=Q_1(P)-Q_0(P)\), the absolute minimax risk and the expected length of globally honest connected intervals both have the exact order \(\min\{1,(n\epsilon^3)^{-2/7}\}\), uniformly for every \(n\geq2\) and public \(0<\epsilon\leq1\) on the stipulated \(\mathcal M\). Explicit total procedures attain this order with finite \(0.90\) coverage, and legal compact alternatives give matching converses for every Borel randomized original-record procedure. The order equals the supplied-propensity benchmark: learning the unknown H\"older-\(1/10\) propensity introduces neither a further rate branch nor a logarithmic factor. Uniform consistency and uniformly vanishing honest expected length along a public sequence are possible exactly when \(n\epsilon_n^3\to\infty\). Identification is given and remains valid at every positive channel parameter. The contribution is the matched estimation and inference frontier for a fixed known outcome-only Laplace channel, obtained by auditing dyadic cubic corrections, sparse overlaps, robust pilots and scalar median inversion.
gap: Clean-outcome higher-order causal quantiles and fixed-error deconvolution quantiles are established. Neither inspected result gives the complete finite, privacy-uniform original-record certificate with an unknown H\"older-\(1/10\) propensity.
fill: Derive the numerical frontier by combining scale-sensitive reciprocal corrections, compact original-likelihood testing and scalar median inversion. Every total procedure and honest radius must be certified on the full stipulated model, including sparse and small-sample branches.
